name: OPTZ
summary: The React framework for Bun this site runs on: HTML by default, islands for interactivity, Server Actions, streaming and ISR. About 40–60× the requests per second of Next.js on one core.

name: The $12 Server Challenge
summary: A social network backend in Rust on raw io_uring and SQLite, built for the $12 Server Challenge: one CPU, 2 GB of memory, as many users as it can hold.
